: A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, never 403 — the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cann
ot see.\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals stil
l reference this persona — deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/updat
e-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the persona by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [
Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and pers
ists nothing. That separation is deliberate: generation is the step most likely to produce something nobody wanted, and a route th
at both invented and saved would make \"let me see what you'd suggest\" indistinguishable from \"fill my project with these\".\n-
[Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and p
ersists nothing — see `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a jou
rney](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
swarms/archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the response says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definitio
n they executed, so their history stays readable.\n- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-jour
ney.md): Editing a goal never disturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.
\n- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one sta
rts nothing.\n- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not touched — they keep th
eir own definitions and stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Chan
ges the container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it keep the values they were created with — this is not a cascade.\n- [
List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goals a
re excluded.\n- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona
pursuing a task against one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/gener
ate` — that route persists nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project'
s credentials as METADATA ONLY — no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller
's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS
IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secr
et requires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.m
d): One secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret f
rom another project — and another member's personal secret — both read as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD — the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops
delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable
until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wa…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches
NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value — materialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy t
hat cannot be read back — and there is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records — `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a j
ourney](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out
has started. It is not finished — poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a j
ourney run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attemp
ts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): O
ne entry per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts — read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `
id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop r
equest and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background; status remains the cur
rent stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0
`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent ru
ns with their goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Deterministic and free — start here.\n
- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The determi
nistic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insight
s/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVER TIME — `occurrenceCou
nt` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a finding from your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing d
oes not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fires again stays `recurring`.\n- [Undismiss a finding](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md): Reverses a dismissal. Bodyless, like its twin.\n- [G
et swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-swarm-run-insights.md): Poll this after requesting
insights. **404 means nobody asked** — it is deliberately not an empty `status: \"none\"` body, so a caller in a polling loop can
not mistake \"never requested\" for \"asked and still working\".\n- [Request swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generation is scheduled, not done. Poll the GET above rather
than re-requesting.\n- [Cancel a pending swarm-run-insights generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/cance
l-a-pending-swarm-run-insights-generation.md): Stops a generation that is still `pending`. A swarm run with no generation in progr
ess answers 409 — there is nothing to cancel, and reporting success would tell a caller it stopped something it did not.\n- [Start
a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-ru
n.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target co
mes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run d
etail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…\n- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
